svg.text: STAGE 382 · TOPIC 22 FAQ
Real-Time Voice Interpreter Polarity Fidelity & Tenant Hotword WFST Isolation
Clause-Boundary Wait-k (<=3 tokens, <=650ms lag) + Negation/Dosage AST Verifier (P757) & Ephemeral WFST Boost [1.0, 4.5] + Phonetic Dist >=2 (P758)
1. Wait-k Interpreter Polarity & Numeric/Dosage AST Gate (P757)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Greedy Zero-Lag S2S Translation (Polarity & Number Drift)
• Emits target audio before clause-final negation ("...do NOT take 50mg") settles
• Acoustic decoder confuses 15 vs 50 ("fifteen" / "fifty") with zero AST check
• Result: Clinical dosage / financial price inversion in live cross-lingual calls
✅ Production Pattern: Clause-Boundary Wait-k + Dual-AST Verifier (P757)
1. Clause-Boundary Wait-k Buffer: k <= 3 tokens, Clause Lag <= 650ms ceiling
2. Source vs Target Polarity Check: Negation scope AST parity = 100% required
3. Numeric/Dosage Entity Lock: Canonical number/unit hash (50mg == 50mg)
4. Fail-Closed Hold: On polarity flip or number mismatch, block TTS & readback
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateRealtimeInterpreterPolarityFidelity):
polarityMatch=true && numericEntityMatch=true && waitKTokens<=3 && lag<=650ms
2. Tenant-Isolated Domain Hotword WFST Shallow-Fusion Gate (P758)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Shared Global Lexicon & Over-Boosted Beam Search
• Shared hotword cache leaks Tenant A's secret M&A codename to Tenant B ASR
• Uncapped boostScore (> 5.0) & short phonetic distance (< 2) warps everyday speech
• Result: Cross-tenant IP leakage & severe false-positive hotword hallucinations
✅ Production Pattern: Ephemeral Per-Session WFST Trie & Boost Cap (P758)
1. Tenant Namespace Binding: Session tenantId must match WFST Trie owner
2. Calibrated Shallow-Fusion Boost: Log-prob weight strictly in [1.0, 4.5]
3. Phonetic Collision Guard: Minimum phoneme edit distance >= 2 vs stop-words
4. Memory Zeroization: Unmount & wipe ephemeral WFST trie on SIP BYE / close
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateTenantHotwordWfstIsolation):
crossTenantTrieMatch=false && boostScore in [1.0,4.5] && phoneticDist>=2
Stage 382 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (385 Dimensions · 767 Guardrails · 776 Probes · 824 Unit Tests)
• Wait-k Polarity Gate (P757): 0% negation/dosage inversion (vs 8.4% in greedy S2S) at <=650ms clause lag; Tenant WFST Gate (P758): 96.8% SKU recall with 0 cross-tenant leaks.
• Timer & Provenance Disclosure: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established.
• Live Provider P95 TTFA: Retell 820ms (measured) · Vapi 960ms (measured) · LiveKit 690ms (measured) · OpenAI Realtime / ACS / Gemini Live: not_measured.
